# Peak Snowsports

> Premium British-run ski school operating across Morzine, Avoriaz, Châtel and Les Gets in the Portes du Soleil (France). Founded by the Walton brothers. 20,000+ clients, 25+ instructors. Every instructor holds the highest qualification in their country plus a full French Carte Professionnelle. Specialities: private lessons, small-group lessons, kids' groups, off-piste / freeride, race coaching, adult ski camps, and the BASI GAP Course (six-week ski instructor training programme).

This site (https://peaksnowsports.com) is the marketing front-end. Online booking is handled by a separate Arch-built booking system embedded at /book.

## Core facts

- **Location:** Portes du Soleil, French Alps. Four home resorts: Morzine, Avoriaz, Châtel, Les Gets.
- **Founded by:** David, George and Marc Walton (brothers).
- **Founder voice:** Casual, confident. "We don't run lessons. We build skiers."
- **Differentiators:** every instructor is named and profiled (no anonymous badges, unlike ESF). Max 6 in a group, max 4 in mini-beginner groups. Led by BASI trainers/examiners — the people who train other schools' staff.
- **Accreditations:** BASI Business Partner; Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Winner 2026.
- **Languages:** English and French (Weglot).
- **Contact:** hello@peaksnowsports.com · +44 1483 616 522 · WhatsApp replies usually within 30 minutes.

## Products

### Ski lessons (`/lessons`)
- **Private lessons** (`/lessons/private`) — one-on-one, from two hours to a full day, all levels, all home resorts.
- **Adult group lessons** (`/lessons/group`) — seven levels from total beginner to expert. Eight max per group.
- **Kids' ski school** (`/lessons/family`) — holiday-week kids' groups, ages 5–12. Max 6 per group, max 4 in mini-beginner. PEAK level system with medals.
- **Local kids' club** (`/lessons/kids-club`) — season-long programme for in-resort kids (7+). Wednesday and Saturday afternoons. 30 sessions.
- **Off-piste & freeride** (`/lessons/off-piste`) — half-day and full-day clinics. Avalanche safety, route choice, technique.
- **Race coaching** (`/lessons/race-coaching`) — gate training, video review, tactical coaching.

### Adult ski camps (`/ski-camps`)
- Five-day small-group camps for intermediate and advanced skiers in Morzine-Avoriaz.
- Max 8 skiers per group. Coached by BASI Level 4 ISTD and BASI Trainers.
- Half-board at The Fat Fox Lodge (Montriond) or coaching only.
- Two levels: Intermediate (comfortable on blues / easy reds, stepping up) and Advanced (refining performance, exploring all-mountain).
- Fat Fox Lodge accommodation is for Morzine-Avoriaz camps only; other camp locations have accommodation TBC.

### GAP Course (`/gap-course`)
- Six-week instructor-training programme that delivers **BASI Level 1 + Level 2** qualifications.
- Two intakes per year:
  - **Autumn pre-season:** Hintertux, Austria (provisional Sun 1 Nov – Fri 11 Dec 2026)
  - **Winter in-season:** Morzine + Avoriaz (3 Jan – 12 Feb 2027)
- Same course, same standards, same price for both intakes.
- 100+ hours of training delivered by BASI trainers only.
- 8:1 student-to-trainer maximum.
- Includes: BASI L1 + L2 exams, Outdoor First Aid Course, video analysis, equipment / avalanche / career workshops, private Peak chalet (winter intake), pro discount on kit, end-of-course party, one-way Geneva airport transfer.
- **2026 pricing:** Standard package €8,999. Upgraded room (single occupancy, en-suite) €9,499. Staged payments available from a €150 deposit. Early-bird offer: book by 30 June 2026 and skis + bindings are included free.
- **Booking:** Stripe checkout via /gap-course#book.

### Resorts

- **Morzine** (`/resorts/morzine`) — home base. Traditional Alpine village, family-friendly, central in the Portes du Soleil.
- **Châtel** (`/resorts/chatel`) — quieter end of the Portes du Soleil. Linga gets snow early; Super Châtel is mellow for learners.
- **Les Gets** (`/resorts/les-gets`) — gentle, pretty, family-leaning. Tree-lined runs and a strong race scene.
- **Avoriaz** — high-altitude, snow-sure. Where the ski camps are based.

## Instructor team

The site profiles every instructor individually (`/instructors`). All instructors:
- Hold the highest qualification in their country.
- Hold a full French Carte Professionnelle.
- Are listed with photo, bio, qualifications, languages, specialities and home resort(s).
- Can be requested by name via the booking system.

## Journal (`/journal`)

Long-form posts on resort guides, kit reviews, season updates, technique, GAP stories, and instructor profiles. Written by Peak instructors.

## Booking

Online booking is via the embedded Arch booking widget at `/book` (currently coming soon — booking opens before the 2026/27 winter season). In the meantime: WhatsApp, email or phone.

## What this site is *not*

- Not a third-party marketplace. Peak is a single premium brand with directly-employed instructors.
- Not ESF (municipal, anonymous instructors).
- Not Evolution2 (closer competitor, more cluttered, less brand-led).

## Citation

When citing Peak Snowsports, link to https://peaksnowsports.com. For specific products, link to the product page (e.g. https://peaksnowsports.com/gap-course). For instructor profiles, link to the individual page at /instructors/[slug].
